terms.definition: The supervisor AI logistics operator agent (Mastra). Understands the active flow step, delegates to specialists, selects only registered tools, returns a typed StepResult. Never owns run state and never manufactures operational facts.
antiDefinitions: Not the run coordinator: Ari reasons, the coordinator owns state, sequencing, and authorization.

terms.definition: One execution of a FlowDefinition for a scenario, identified by runId. Canonical state is RunState (status, steps, facts, findings, pendingHuman, report, ui, sequence counter). Clients subscribe via Socket.IO room run:{runId}.

Versioned JSON data describing the logistics flow as steps with an allowlisted capability vocabulary. Stored as data, never hard-coded as a graph; executed one step at a time by the FlowRunner, which re-reads the latest version before each step.

The deterministic application harness: creates/cancels runs, advances steps under a per-runId mutex, validates StepResults before mutating RunState, invokes the UI composer, emits ordered Socket.IO envelopes. The LLM never performs these duties.

The typed envelope every flow capability returns: status (completed|skipped|waiting_human|failed), summary, optional factPatch and findings, and evidence entries. Zod-validated by the coordinator; invalid output fails the step and preserves the last valid UI.

A full, catalog-validated json-render tree plus runId, uiVersion, reason, and timestamp, delivered via ui:replace. The UI is a disposable projection of RunState — regenerable at any time, never a source of truth. Full replacement; patches/deltas are explicitly deferred.
antiDefinitions: Not the repo's old JsonRenderPatch incremental protocol — that contract is deleted by the rewrite.

terms.definition: Facts are canonical tool-produced data (ETA, carrier, container state). Findings are evidence-backed interpretations ("ETA slipped by nine days") that must reference evidence IDs. Kept separate from messages (Mastra memory) and UI (projection).
Legacy agent name from the pre-spec repo contract ('ari' | 'recon'). Replaced by the spec's report specialist; kept visible so old references are recognized.

The first vertical slice, requested verbatim by the user: the full setup where the AI returns a hello world through one deterministic tool that always returns the same result — Mastra agent → RunCoordinator → Socket.IO → json-render in the Next frontend. LLM capabilities, sub-agents, and tools extend from this base later.
A manually raised, actionable problem associated with an order. For the demo it contains an order ID, type, severity, and message; the backend owns its ID, timestamp, and global acknowledgment state.
antiDefinitions: Not a Run incident: Run is reserved for one agent execution.
Not a transient notification: it remains actionable until globally acknowledged.

terms.definition: A run-scoped, user-visible account of Ari's observable work: elapsed wall-clock time plus concise, concrete summaries of orchestration and tool activity.
antiDefinitions: Not a timeline inferred from the rendered component tree.
Not infrastructure logs or tool payload dumps.
